name: japanready
description: JapanReady — Japan compatibility infrastructure for software teams

scripts.build: npm run build -w @japanready/core && npm run build -w @japanready/testkit
scripts.corpus: npm run build:core && npm run corpus -w @japanready/testkit
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/testkit/tsconfig.json
scripts.demo: npm run build && node packages/testkit/dist/cli.js test --reference
scripts.demo:naive: npm run build && node packages/testkit/dist/cli.js test --config examples/naive-app/japanready.config.ts --fail-on never
